title: B-track point-in-time news observation v1
description: Single frozen text observation for research-only news→direction pipelines. as_of_utc is the earliest clock time at which this signal may enter a backtest feature row (point-in-time). Not for A-track or live triggers.

observation_id.description: Globally unique id for this observation row.

as_of_utc.description: Earliest time this observation may be used in simulation (max of publish / embargo lift).

published_utc.description: First public availability time from the source when known.

embargo_lift_utc.description: Optional: when embargo lifts if later than published_utc.

source_id.description: Catalog key for the feed (e.g. reuters_wire, internal_rss).

source_record_url.description: Stable URL or internal doc id for audit/replay.

canonical_text.description: Normalized headline/body under fixed newline/whitespace rules.

ingested_at_utc.description: Pipeline first-persist time (audit only; do not use as trading clock).

dataset_partition.description: Fixed before peeking at eval outcomes; no post-hoc moves.

supersedes_observation_id.description: If this row replaces a corrected-withdrawn predecessor, link here.
